FIX 2 (dome position): both Reviewers raised this formally and in near-identical words - reviewer-b ('noticeably to the RIGHT of the walkway's centre line') and reviewer-d ('noticeably right of centre, on a rise beside the water, not on the path's centre line') - and both independently logged 'right of center' in their blind observations.
